Today on placement I helped with a patient who became more breathless and confused. I did a full set of obs with my mentor and the NEWS2 was higher than earlier. I felt nervous but I stayed with the patient, repeated the obs, and escalated using SBAR. The doctor reviewed the patient quickly and oxygen was adjusted to target range. I learnt that early escalation matters more than worrying about sounding silly. I also need to improve how confidently I hand over.

What went well
• Stayed calm and stayed with the patient
• repeated obs and checked NEWS2
• asked for help and escalated using SBAR

To improve
• improve confidence when escalating
• be more concise in SBAR / handover
• learn the local escalation policy / pathway
